hypothesis: The already selected 25% blend will reduce actual archive bytes versus the prior one-pass checkpoint on a third geographically separate enwik8 article range without changing code, contexts or model size.
rule: Build untouched, prior and frozen blend serially on one native Linux host; compare one archive each on identical prepared input and verify exact original XML restoration and all encoder/decoder context counters. Preserve a loss as well as a gain. Do not tune on this range.
promotion_gate: Blend payload smaller than prior on this range with exact restoration and identical contexts. This is a supporting third-range check, not a final full-input validation.
scope: The 150-page, 1,000,794-byte raw XML range was already used for an unrelated retrieval comparison and prior fixed-weight trial. The same range and full corpus are not untouched validation; fixture payloads and development binaries are not Hutter Prize scores.
